segments.he:
א.

מִי שֶׁסָּבְאוֹ מָהוּל בְּמַיִם, הַשָּׂרִים אֵינָם נוֹהֲגִים עִמּוֹ בְּיַשְׁרָנוּת.
segments.en: limbs of a man  and in each and every limb, he warns the man regarding the  Mitzvot contingent to it. Because of this Moshe is called “Mechokek”  (one who inscribes the law), which has the  Gematria (numerical value)  of 248 (Likutay Moharan II:26) .

segments.he:
ב.

מִי שֶׁאֵין דָּן אֶת חֲבֵרוֹ לְכַף־זְכוּת, כְּאִלּוּ הֲרָגוֹ, גַּם הַשָּׂרִים אֵינָם נוֹהֲגִים עִמּוֹ בְּיַשְׁרָנוּת.
segments.en: Through drunkenness, one removes the kindness which clothe the 'daas'  (realization of knowledge) ,  and clothe it  (the daas)  with intense harshness, G-d forbid.

segments.he:
ג.

אֲמִירַת הַלֵּל וּצְדָקָה מְסֻגָּלִין לְחֵן בְּעֵינֵי הַשָּׂר.
segments.en: One who has enemies should swear off wine, and through this he will become their head.

segments.he:
ד.

עַל־יְדֵי אֲכִילַת פַּת עַכּוּ"ם מוֹנְעִין הַיַּעַר מִלַּחְטֹב עֵצִים.
segments.en: One who's wine is diluted  with water  (t.n. this is most probably referring to wine for sale , see theft #10 ) , the officials do not deal with him in a straight manner.

segments.he:
ה.

בִּשְׁבִיל אַרְבָּעָה דְּבָרִים נִכְסֵי בַּעֲלֵי־בָּתִּים נִמְסָרִים לַמַּלְכוּת.
segments.en: One who does not judge his fellow favorably is as if he killed him. Also the officials do not deal with him in a straight manner.
Saying of  Hallel  and giving charity are a  segulah (conducive)  to  [having]  favor in the eyes of the minister.
Through eating bread baked by a non-Jew, the forest is prohibited from cutting down its  trees.

Due to four things, the property of householders is handed over to the government  (monarchy) . [1) Keeping a note of debt after it has been paid off; 2) Charging interest; 3) Remaining silent in a case where one should speak out against evil; and  4) Promising to make a donation in public and not carrying through.]
